description: Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm that, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, advises, and originates, trades, manages and distributes capital for governments, institutions and individuals. It was originally incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1981 and its predecessor companies date back to 1924, and it is a financial holding company regulated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System under the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended, conducting its business from its headquarters in and around New York City, its regional offices and branches throughout the U.S. and its principal offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other world financial centers.
